commands.name: floodgate-firewall
commands.label: Firewall check
commands.description: Check if your outgoing firewall allows Floodgate to work properly.

commands.name: fwhitelist-add
commands.label: Whitelist Bedrock player
commands.description: Adds a Floodgate (Bedrock) player to whitelist.json; the username prefix doesn't need to be included.

commands.name: fwhitelist-remove
commands.label: Remove from whitelist
commands.description: Removes a Floodgate (Bedrock) player from whitelist.json; the username prefix doesn't need to be included.
